title: Before you sell a home in Western Australia
description: What to sort out before you sign an offer and acceptance and before settlement in WA. Summarised from Consumer Protection, Building and Energy, Landgate and RevenueWA guidance.

sources.title: Real estate contracts: sale by offer and acceptance
Smoke alarm laws for homes being sold, rented and hired
Councils urged to stay buoyant on pool barrier inspections

items.title: Choose a licensed settlement agent or a lawyer
items.detail: They handle the transfer, adjustments and mortgage discharge at settlement.

items.title: Read the offer and acceptance and the Joint Form of General Conditions before you sign
items.detail: Check the settlement date, finance and inspection conditions and any special conditions.

items.title: Tell your agent and settlement agent about anything that affects the property
items.detail: For example unapproved building work, a tenancy, a pool, easements or disputes.

items.title: Have mains-powered smoke alarms, no more than 10 years old, installed before transfer
items.detail: Interconnected if more than one and the building permit was applied for after 1 May 2015. Use a licensed electrical contractor.

items.title: Make sure at least two RCDs protect all power and lighting circuits before transfer
items.detail: Keep the electrician's invoice for your settlement agent.

items.title: If strata: give the strata disclosure before the buyer signs
items.detail: Use the WA strata seller disclosure statement with the scheme documents, minutes, accounts and levy estimate.

items.title: If strata: tell the buyer in writing about notifiable variations within 10 working days
If there's a pool or spa: check the barrier and get the last council inspection result
If tenanted: decide on vacant possession or selling with the tenant, and give notice on the WA notice of termination if needed
items.detail: At least 30 days for a periodic tenancy after the sale contract; you can't end a fixed term early.

items.title: If mortgaged: tell your lender you are selling so the discharge is ready for settlement
Gather recent council rates and water bills for the settlement adjustments
